translation_en: Hudbah ibn Khalid narrated to us: Hammam ibn Yahya narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, from Malik ibn Sa‘sa‘ah, may Allah be pleased with them both, that the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, told them about the night he was taken on the Night Journey. He said, ‘While I was lying down in al-Hatim—or perhaps he said, in al-Hijr—a visitor came to me and slit me open.’ He said: I heard him say, ‘He split open what lay between here and here.’ I asked al-Jarud, who was beside me, ‘What does he mean by that?’ He said, ‘From the hollow of his throat to his pubic hair.’ I also heard him say, ‘From his chest to his pubic hair.’ He said, ‘My heart was taken out. Then a gold basin filled with faith was brought to me. My heart was washed and then filled. Then a white animal was brought to me, smaller than a mule and larger than a donkey.’ Al-Jarud said to him, ‘It was al-Buraq, Abu Hamzah.’ Anas said, ‘Yes. It placed its step at the farthest point it could see.’ He said, ‘I was carried on it, and Jibril set out with me until he came to the lowest heaven. He asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” Then it was opened. When I entered, I saw Adam. He said, “This is your father, Adam. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. Then he said, “Welcome to the righteous son and righteous prophet.” Then he ascended until he came to the second heaven and asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” Then it was opened. When I entered, I saw Yahya and ‘Isa, the two sons of maternal cousins. He said, “These are Yahya and ‘Isa. Greet them.” I greeted them, and they returned the greeting. Then they said, “Welcome to the righteous brother and righteous prophet.” Then he ascended with me to the third heaven and asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” Then it was opened. When I entered, I saw Yusuf. He said, “This is Yusuf. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. Then he said, “Welcome to the righteous brother and righteous prophet.” Then he ascended with me until he came to the fourth heaven and asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” Then it was opened. When I entered, I saw Idris. He said, “This is Idris. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. Then he said, “Welcome to the righteous brother and righteous prophet.” Then he ascended with me until he came to the fifth heaven and asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” When I entered, I saw Harun. He said, “This is Harun. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. Then he said, “Welcome to the righteous brother and righteous prophet.” Then he ascended with me until he came to the sixth heaven and asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent for?” He said, “Yes.” He said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” When I entered, I saw Musa. He said, “This is Musa. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. Then he said, “Welcome to the righteous brother and righteous prophet.” When I passed him, he wept. He was asked, “What makes you weep?” He said, “I weep because a young man was sent after me, and more people from his community will enter Paradise than from my community.” Then he ascended with me to the seventh heaven. Jibril asked for the gate to be opened. He was asked, “Who is this?” He said, “Jibril.” He was asked, “Who is with you?” He said, “Muhammad.” He was asked, “Has he been sent?” He said, “Yes.” It was said, “He is welcome. What an excellent arrival.” When I entered, I saw Ibrahim. He said, “This is your father. Greet him.” I greeted him, and he returned the greeting. He said, “Welcome to the righteous son and righteous prophet.” Then the Lote Tree of the Farthest Boundary was raised up for me. Its berries were like the large jars of Hajar, and its leaves were like the ears of elephants. He said, “This is the Lote Tree of the Farthest Boundary.” There were four rivers: two hidden rivers and two visible rivers. I said, “What are these, Jibril?” He said, “As for the two hidden rivers, they are two rivers in Paradise. As for the two visible ones, they are the Nile and the Euphrates.” Then the Frequented House was raised up for me. Then a vessel of wine, a vessel of milk, and a vessel of honey were brought to me. I chose the milk. He said, “It is the natural way. You and your community are upon it.” Then fifty prayers were prescribed for me each day. I returned and passed by Musa. He said, “What were you commanded to do?” I said, “I was commanded to pray fifty times each day.” He said, “Your community will not be able to pray fifty times each day. By Allah, I have tested people before you and dealt with the Children of Israel with the greatest difficulty. Return to your Lord and ask Him to lessen it for your community.” I returned, and He took ten away from me. I went back to Musa, and he said the same. I returned, and He took ten away from me. I went back to Musa, and he said the same. I returned, and He took ten away from me. I went back to Musa, and he said the same. I returned and was commanded to pray ten times each day. I returned, and he said the same. I returned and was commanded to pray five times each day. I went back to Musa. He said, “What were you commanded to do?” I said, “I was commanded to pray five times each day.” He said, “Your community will not be able to pray five times each day. I have tested people before you and dealt with the Children of Israel with the greatest difficulty. Return to your Lord and ask Him to lessen it for your community.” I said, “I have asked my Lord until I felt too shy to ask again, but I am content and submit.” He said: When I had gone on, a caller called out, “I have confirmed My obligation and made it lighter for My servants.”’
